Real mind map files used as test fixtures. Each is unchanged, from a public GitHub repository under a permissive license.
They are test data only and are not part of the packaged extension.

overview.km            https://github.com/jecyu/Web-Performance-Optimization/blob/master/docs/cache/overview.km   MIT, Copyright (c) 2020 Lin Jiyu
observability.km       https://github.com/kubegems/design/blob/main/observability.km                             Apache-2.0, kubegems authors
3steps.mm              https://github.com/romilly/fm2md/blob/master/data/3steps.mm                               MIT, Copyright (c) 2014 Romilly Cocking
CoffeeScad.mm          https://github.com/kaosat-dev/CoffeeSCad/blob/dev/doc/CoffeeScad.mm                       MIT, Copyright (C) 2013 Mark "kaosat-dev" Moissette
new.mm                 https://github.com/Jinntec/Fore/blob/dev/demo/xmind/new.mm                                MIT, Copyright (c) 2021 Jinntec, Joern Turner
MVC-MVP-MVVM.mm        https://github.com/quanru/bagu/blob/main/resource/MVC-MVP-MVVM.mm                         MIT, Copyright (c) 2021 quanru
assessment_mindset.opml https://github.com/dsopas/assessment-mindset/blob/master/assessment_mindset.opml         MIT, Copyright (c) 2018 David Sopas
note-blocks.opml       https://github.com/mfkrause/carta/blob/main/corpus/text/opml/note-blocks.opml             Apache-2.0, carta authors
